pages.title: The Ridge's own
text: The moonstone heights of the [Glimmer Ridge](glimmer_ridge) keep a plated grazer and a moth in the open, and a glowworm and a crystal spider in the caves below.

Every gentle beast here can be brushed for its reagent once a minute, and is tempted and bred with its own food, named under **Hunting and herding** below. It can be bonded like any gentle animal (see [familiars](familiars)), and though none has a gift of its own, a bonded one can still take a voice at a totem and strengthen your magic (see [attuning at a totem](familiar_attuning)).

pages.title: Prism Grazer
text: A low lizard grazer with a row of prism plates down its back, in herds of two to four. **24 health** and **3 armour**.
It drops **1 to 3 Prism Crests**, more with Looting.
Hunted, it also drops 1 to 2 Raw Game and up to 1 March Leather. Breed with **Glimmer Beans**.

pages.title: Shardmoth
text: A violet moth with cut-crystal wings that flutters over the ridge in ones to threes. **10 health**, no armour.
Hunted, it also drops up to 1 String and up to 1 Amethyst Shard. Breed with **Glimmer Beans**.

pages.title: Glowgrub
text: A glowworm, long and segmented under a big dark head, its tail end burning, of the dark caves under the ridge, one to three at a time. **18 health** and **1 armour**. It is gentle, and flees from monsters like any grazer.
Hunted, it also drops up to 2 Glowstone Dust. Breed with **Lantern Caps or any mushroom**.

pages.title: Facet Stalker
text: A crystal spider of the same caves. It rises in the dark there day or night, one or two at a time. It has **21 health** and **1 armour**, is quick, and its bite does **5** and poisons you for 3 seconds.
It drops **1 to 2 Facet Barbs**, a Venom reagent.
Hunted, it also drops up to 1 Amethyst Shard and up to 1 String.

pages.title: Hunting and herding
text: Besides its reagent, each one drops more when hunted, and more again with Looting. Meat drops roasted if the animal died burning. To breed wild ones, **sneak** while you feed two adults their food; fed normally, a wild one warms to you instead.
